#!/bin/bash
# YOLO Pose Detection - Linux Build Script
# Author: Chris
# Date: 2025-10-17

set -e  # Exit on error

echo "========================================="
echo "  YOLO Pose Detection - Linux Build"
echo "========================================="
echo ""

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to print colored messages
print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

print_success() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

# Check if running from project directory
if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then
    print_error "CMakeLists.txt not found! Please run this script from YOLO project directory."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[1/5] Checking dependencies..."

# Check CMake
if ! command -v cmake &> /dev/null; then
    print_error "CMake not found! Please install: sudo apt-get install cmake"
    exit 1
fi
print_success "CMake found: $(cmake --version | head -n1)"

# Check GCC
if ! command -v g++ &> /dev/null; then
    print_error "G++ not found! Please install: sudo apt-get install build-essential"
    exit 1
fi
print_success "G++ found: $(g++ --version | head -n1)"

# Check OpenCV
if ! pkg-config --exists opencv; then
    print_warning "OpenCV not found via pkg-config"
    print_warning "Please install: sudo apt-get install libopencv-dev"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
else
    print_success "OpenCV found: $(pkg-config --modversion opencv)"
fi

# Check ONNX Runtime (支持 Conda 环境)
ONNX_FOUND=false
if [ -n "$CONDA_PREFIX" ] && [ -f "$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/libonnxruntime.so" ]; then
    print_success "ONNX Runtime found in Conda: $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/"
    ONNX_FOUND=true
elif [ -f "/usr/local/lib/libonnxruntime.so" ]; then
    print_success "ONNX Runtime found in /usr/local/lib/"
    ONNX_FOUND=true
fi

if [ "$ONNX_FOUND" = false ]; then
    print_warning "ONNX Runtime not found!"
    print_warning "For GPU version: conda activate your_env && pip install onnxruntime-gpu"
    print_warning "For CPU version: ./install_onnxruntime.sh"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Check required directories
if [ ! -d "include" ]; then
    print_error "include/ directory not found!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "lib/libindemind.so" ]; then
    print_error "lib/libindemind.so not found!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "models/yolov8n-pose.onnx" ]; then
    print_warning "YOLO model not found!"
    print_warning "Please run: python3 prepare_yolo_model.py"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "[2/5] Cleaning old build..."
if [ -d "build" ]; then
    rm -rf build
    print_success "Old build directory removed"
fi

echo ""
echo "[3/5] Creating build directory..."
mkdir -p build
cd build

echo ""
echo "[4/5] Configuring CMake..."
if cmake ..; then
    print_success "CMake configuration successful"
else
    print_error "CMake configuration failed!"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "[5/5] Building project..."
if make -j$(nproc); then
    print_success "Build successful!"
else
    print_error "Build failed!"
    exit 1
fi

cd ..

echo ""
echo "========================================="
echo "  Build Successful!"
echo "========================================="
echo ""
echo "Executable location: build/yolo_pose_detection"
echo ""
echo "To run:"
echo "  1. Ensure IMSEE camera is connected"
echo "  2. Check USB permissions: lsusb"
echo "  3. Run: sudo ./build/yolo_pose_detection"
echo ""
echo "For more information, see README.md"

# YOLO Pose Detection - Standalone Project
# Can be deployed to any directory or Windows system
# Author: Chris
# Date: 2025-10-17

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(YOLOPoseDetection VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

message(STATUS "=========================================")
message(STATUS "  YOLO Pose Detection Standalone Build")
message(STATUS "=========================================")
message(STATUS "Build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
message(STATUS "Project directory: ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# ============================================
# Platform Detection
# ============================================
if(WIN32)
    set(OS_WINDOWS TRUE)
    message(STATUS "Platform: Windows")
elseif(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    set(OS_LINUX TRUE)
    message(STATUS "Platform: Linux")
elseif(APPLE)
    set(OS_MACOS TRUE)
    message(STATUS "Platform: macOS")
endif()

# ============================================
# Compiler Flags
# ============================================
if(MSVC)
    # Windows MSVC compiler
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /W3")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} /O2")
else()
    # GCC/Clang (Linux/macOS)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wall -Wextra")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O3 -march=native")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} -g -O0")
endif()

message(STATUS "CXX Flags: ${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")

# ============================================
# Find Dependencies
# ============================================

# 1. OpenCV (Required)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)
if(OpenCV_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "✓ Found OpenCV: ${OpenCV_VERSION}")
    message(STATUS "  Include: ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
    message(STATUS "  Libraries: ${OpenCV_LIBS}")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "✗ OpenCV not found! Please install OpenCV.")
endif()

# 2. ONNX Runtime (Required) - 优先使用 Conda 环境中的 GPU 版本
# 检测 Conda 环境
if(DEFINED ENV{CONDA_PREFIX})
    set(CONDA_PREFIX $ENV{CONDA_PREFIX})
    message(STATUS "✓ Detected Conda environment: ${CONDA_PREFIX}")

    # 优先从 Conda 环境查找
    find_path(ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR
        NAMES onnxruntime_cxx_api.h
        PATHS
            ${CONDA_PREFIX}/include/onnxruntime
            ${CONDA_PREFIX}/include
        NO_DEFAULT_PATH
        DOC "ONNX Runtime include directory"
    )

    find_library(ONNXRUNTIME_LIB
        NAMES onnxruntime
        PATHS
            ${CONDA_PREFIX}/lib
        NO_DEFAULT_PATH
        DOC "ONNX Runtime library"
    )
endif()

# 如果 Conda 环境中没找到，再从系统路径查找
if(NOT ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT ONNXRUNTIME_LIB)
    find_path(ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR
        NAMES onnxruntime_cxx_api.h
        PATHS
            /usr/local/include/onnxruntime
            /usr/include/onnxruntime
            C:/Program\ Files/onnxruntime/include
            ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime/include
        DOC "ONNX Runtime include directory"
    )

    find_library(ONNXRUNTIME_LIB
        NAMES onnxruntime
        PATHS
            /usr/local/lib
            /usr/lib
            C:/Program\ Files/onnxruntime/lib
            ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/onnxruntime/lib
        DOC "ONNX Runtime library"
    )
endif()

if(ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR AND ONNXRUNTIME_LIB)
    message(STATUS "✓ Found ONNX Runtime")
    message(STATUS "  Include: ${ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR}")
    message(STATUS "  Library: ${ONNXRUNTIME_LIB}")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "✗ ONNX Runtime not found!\n"
        "  Please install ONNX Runtime:\n"
        "  - Linux: Run ./install_onnxruntime.sh\n"
        "  - Windows: Download from https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases\n"
        "  Or set ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR and ONNXRUNTIME_LIB manually.")
endif()

# 3. IMSEE SDK (Required)
# Look for libindemind.so in current directory's lib folder
set(IMSEE_INCLUDE_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
set(IMSEE_LIB_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib)

if(WIN32)
    set(IMSEE_LIB ${IMSEE_LIB_DIR}/indemind.lib)
    set(IMSEE_DLL ${IMSEE_LIB_DIR}/indemind.dll)
else()
    set(IMSEE_LIB ${IMSEE_LIB_DIR}/libindemind.so)
endif()

# Check if IMSEE SDK files exist
if(EXISTS ${IMSEE_INCLUDE_DIR}/imrsdk.h AND EXISTS ${IMSEE_LIB})
    message(STATUS "✓ Found IMSEE SDK")
    message(STATUS "  Include: ${IMSEE_INCLUDE_DIR}")
    message(STATUS "  Library: ${IMSEE_LIB}")
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "✗ IMSEE SDK not found!\n"
        "  Expected locations:\n"
        "    Headers: ${IMSEE_INCLUDE_DIR}/\n"
        "    Library: ${IMSEE_LIB}\n"
        "  Please copy SDK files to these locations.")
endif()

# ============================================
# Include Directories
# ============================================
include_directories(
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/app
    ${IMSEE_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    ${ONNXRUNTIME_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

# ============================================
# Source Files
# ============================================
set(COMMON_SOURCES
    yolo_pose_detector.cpp
    pose_utils.cpp
)

set(COMMON_HEADERS
    yolo_pose_detector.h
    pose_utils.h
)

set(APP_SOURCES
    app/camera_intrinsics.cpp
    app/depth_region.cpp
    app/depth_utils.cpp
    app/perf_stats.cpp
    app/runtime_state.cpp
)

# ============================================
# Build Executables
# ============================================

# YOLO Pose INDEMIND Left Camera (RGB only, no depth)
add_executable(yolo_pose_indemind_left
    get_pose_indemind_left.cpp
    ${COMMON_SOURCES}
    ${COMMON_HEADERS}
    ${APP_SOURCES}
)

set_target_properties(yolo_pose_indemind_left PROPERTIES
#    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/build
    OUTPUT_NAME "yolo_pose_indemind_left"
)

)

target_link_libraries(yolo_pose_indemind_left
    ${IMSEE_LIB}
    ${OpenCV_LIBS}
    ${ONNXRUNTIME_LIB}
)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(yolo_pose_indemind_left pthread)
endif()

if(UNIX)
    set_target_properties(yolo_pose_indemind_left PROPERTIES
        BUILD_RPATH "${IMSEE_LIB_DIR}"
        INSTALL_RPATH "${IMSEE_LIB_DIR}:$ORIGIN/../lib"

endif()

# ============================================

install(TARGETS yolo_pose_indemind_left

# ============================================
# Post-build: Copy DLLs on Windows

if(WIN32 AND EXISTS ${IMSEE_DLL})
    add_custom_command(TARGET yolo_pose_detection POST_BUILD

# ============================================

message(STATUS "=========================================")
message(STATUS "  Build Configuration Summary")
message(STATUS "=========================================")

message(STATUS "  ✓ ONNX Runtime")

    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARNING]${NC} $1"
}

# Check if running from project directory
if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ]; then
    print_error "CMakeLists.txt not found! Please run this script from YOLO_rec project directory."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[1/5] Checking dependencies..."

# Check CMake
if ! command -v cmake &> /dev/null; then
    print_error "CMake not found! Please install: sudo apt-get install cmake"
    exit 1
fi
print_success "CMake found: $(cmake --version | head -n1)"

# Check GCC
if ! command -v g++ &> /dev/null; then
    print_error "G++ not found! Please install: sudo apt-get install build-essential"
    exit 1
fi
print_success "G++ found: $(g++ --version | head -n1)"

# Check OpenCV
if ! pkg-config --exists opencv; then
    print_warning "OpenCV not found via pkg-config"
    print_warning "Please install: sudo apt-get install libopencv-dev"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
else
    print_success "OpenCV found: $(pkg-config --modversion opencv)"
fi

# Check ONNX Runtime (supports Conda)
ONNX_FOUND=false
if [ -n "$CONDA_PREFIX" ] && [ -f "$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/libonnxruntime.so" ]; then
    print_success "ONNX Runtime found in Conda: $CONDA_PREFIX/lib/"
    ONNX_FOUND=true
elif [ -f "/usr/local/lib/libonnxruntime.so" ]; then
    print_success "ONNX Runtime found in /usr/local/lib/"
    ONNX_FOUND=true
fi

if [ "$ONNX_FOUND" = false ]; then
    print_warning "ONNX Runtime not found!"
    print_warning "For GPU version: conda activate your_env && pip install onnxruntime-gpu"
    print_warning "For CPU version: ./install_onnxruntime.sh"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Check required directories
if [ ! -d "include" ]; then
    print_error "include/ directory not found!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "lib/libindemind.so" ]; then
    print_error "lib/libindemind.so not found!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "models/yolov8n-pose.onnx" ]; then
    print_warning "YOLO model not found!"
    print_warning "Please ensure models/yolov8n-pose.onnx exists"
    echo -n "Continue anyway? (y/n): "
    read -r response
    if [ "$response" != "y" ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo ""
echo "[2/5] Cleaning old build..."
if [ -d "build" ]; then
    rm -rf build
    print_success "Old build directory removed"
fi

echo ""
echo "[3/5] Creating build directory..."
mkdir -p build
cd build

echo ""
echo "[4/5] Configuring CMake..."
if cmake ..; then
    print_success "CMake configuration successful"
else
    print_error "CMake configuration failed!"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "[5/5] Building project..."
if make -j$(nproc); then
    print_success "Build successful!"
else
    print_error "Build failed!"
    exit 1
fi

cd ..

echo ""
echo "========================================="
echo "  Build Successful!"
echo "========================================="
echo ""
echo "Executable location: build/yolo_pose_indemind_left"
echo ""
echo "To run:"
echo "  1. Ensure IMSEE camera is connected"
echo "  2. Check USB permissions: lsusb"
echo "  3. Run: sudo ./build/yolo_pose_indemind_left"
echo ""
echo "For more information, see README.md"
EOF'
